blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defending champion Criss Cross no longer its fate after a 0-2 start in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference semifinals. Jude Garcia carried Criss Cross with 18 points, but only to get swept by Savouge, 25-15, 25-21, 25-17, on Wednesday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan. “First of all, we have to accept the loss because I feel that Savouge wanted the win more than we did. This is probably a wake-up call for us,” said Garcia in Filipino. “Since the start of the preliminaries, it has always come down to how much each team wants to win, […]...
